title.zh: 就业第 2 号修正命令 2015(1)

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《s-62-2015-e-employment-amendment-no-2-order-2015(1).pdf》（3 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Employment (Amendment) (No. 2) Order, of new section 113A into S 37/2009

The Employment Order, 2009 is amended by inserting the following new immediately after section 113 - "Medical insurance 113A. (1) The employer shall purchase and maintain medical insurance with coverage of at least $10,000 for a 12 month period of the immigrant employment (or for such shorter period where the immigrant period of employment is less than 12 months) for the immigrant in-patient care and day surgery except as the Commissioner may otherwise provide by notification in writing.

(2) For the purposes of subsection ( 1), where the employer purchases medical insurance policy for his immigrant employees, the employer not be considered to have satisfied the obligation under subsection (1) the terms of the employer's group medical insurance policy are such that each and every individual immigrant employee is concurrently covered to the extent required under that subsection. Any employer who, for the purpose of defraying or partly the cost of insurance in respect of his liability to pay medical under subsection ( 1), makes any deduction from the earnings of an employee employed by him is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction to a fine of $2,000, imprisonment for a term not 6 or both.

(4) Any employer who fails to comply with subsection (1) is guilty of an offence.". Made this 9th. day of Rabiulawal, 1436 Hijriah corresponding to the 21st. day of December, 2015 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
